composition.badge: One solid dark red circle, centered, filling approximately 85% of the square canvas. Everything outside the circle is fully transparent.
composition.pictogram: One large white casino-style gaming chip viewed almost front-on with a slight tilt. Use a bold circular silhouette, four pairs of simple edge notches, one thick inner ring, and one plain solid central circle. The chip fills approximately 55% of the badge.
composition.alignment: Perfectly centered horizontally and vertically, with generous clear space around the pictogram.

style: Flat two-color board-game category icon matching the existing repository badges. Clean vector-like edges, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no outline beyond the white silhouette.
constraints: Use only the dark red badge color and white pictogram color.
No currency symbols, numbers, letters, card suits, dice pips, logos, words, hands, people, buildings, roulette wheel, playing cards, or extra objects.
The object must read as a single gaming chip at very small print size.
No transparency holes inside the dark red circle except where required around the white pictogram.
Keep the entire badge inside the canvas with transparent padding on all sides.
